Compare · cameras · Canon vs Nikon

Canon EOS R6 V vs Nikon ZR. Two small full-frame video cameras, two different bets.

Both put a full-frame sensor, internal RAW and 7.5 stops of stabilisation in a body with no viewfinder. Canon bets on resolution, open gate and a cooling fan; Nikon on RED’s RAW and colour, 32-bit audio and a bigger screen. i9Store sells the Canon; this page compares both honestly.

The short answer

Canon EOS R6 V

if you shoot stills and social too, run long takes or streams, or own Canon lenses.

Nikon ZR

if you grade in a RED workflow, need 32-bit audio in camera, or own Nikon Z lenses.

R6 V vs ZR questions.

Where to buy, RAW, audio, viewfinders, weight and accessories.

Does i9Store sell the Nikon ZR?

Not in the USA store today: the ZR’s page on i9store.com/usa read “Product unavailable at i9Store USA” on 26 Nov 2026. In Brazil, the i9Store Brasil marketplace lists it with the price on request. Ask the i9 team if you need one.

Which one records RAW inside the camera?

Both. Canon lists 7K RAW (Light) at up to 60p for the R6 V. Nikon lists 6K at up to 60p in R3D NE, plus N-RAW and ProRes RAW HQ, for the ZR.

Which has the better audio?

On paper the ZR has more headroom: Nikon lists 32-bit float recording (not in H.264) and built-in mics with five pickup patterns. Canon lists 24-bit audio with up to four channels for the R6 V.

Do either of them have a viewfinder?

No. Neither maker lists a viewfinder. The R6 V has a 3.0-inch vari-angle screen; the ZR a 4-inch, 1000-nit screen.

Which one is lighter?

The makers use different bases. Canon gives 688 g with battery and card for the R6 V; Nikon gives 535 g without battery and cards for the ZR. Weigh them the same way before deciding on weight alone.

I already own a Nikon ZR. Does i9Store sell accessories for it?

Yes. i9Store USA lists SmallRig and Kondor Blue cages and a SmallRig cooling fan made for the ZR (see below).
